All synced.differences: Design shows the record list with a green 'All changes uploaded' bar and a '2 conflicts saved to the log / Review' row. Checked against the live list after a sync; stat cards and filter tabs are extra in the build.

Back online.differences: Build shows the 'You are back online' notice inside the list under the stat cards and tabs; the status bar reads 'Back online / Starting sync' only for a moment before it changes to 'Syncing n of m'.

Conflict log.differences: Layout matches. Build keeps the status bar and bottom nav on this screen (design has neither). Labels say 'Kept / <name>' and 'Overwritten / you' instead of device letters. A restored entry shows 'Restored.' in place of the Restore button.

Delete confirm.differences: Same sheet, same rows, same buttons.

GPS tracks.differences: Idle state has a Track name field and one Start recording button; the design shows only the recording state with Pause and Stop. The build has no Pause button while recording.

iPhone, install.differences: Status bar says 'Online / install' (design 'Online / safari'). The share icon next to 'Tap Share' is missing. 'App files cached' showed 'Preparing' on the first visit.

iPhone, records.differences: The 'Add to Home Screen' hint sits under the filter tabs instead of above the title. The design has no filter tabs on this screen.

Laptop, data lead.differences: Same structure. With long region names and long record titles the table columns Last edit / At / Status and the Export CSV / Refresh buttons can be pushed to the right edge (checked by K02). The build adds Sign out in the side list.

Laptop, sign in.differences: Build shows the status bar on top; the design has none on this screen. Rest matches.

New record.differences: Build adds a Title field above the readings, which pushes the GPS box below the fold on a 390 x 844 screen. Bottom nav is shown under the Save button (not in the design).

Permissions blocked.differences: Same layout and texts. Captured with permissions not yet asked, so the badges read 'Not asked yet' instead of 'Blocked' (C05 and D02 check the Blocked state).

Record detail.differences: Region label is written 'qA-...' (first letter lowercased). Empty readings show '--'. Bottom nav is shown under Edit / Delete (not in the design).

Records.differences: Same layout. Status marker for Synced is a slightly larger ring.

Regions.differences: Build adds a 'This device' list (Install, Storage, Conflict log), 'Signed in as' and Sign out below the regions. The notice text is larger than in the design.

Storage almost full.differences: Build adds a 'Storage protection' row. Notice text is larger and wraps to two lines.

Style guide.differences: Colour swatches are all the same size (design has two wide ones). Build adds the status bar and a 'Back to the app' button.

Sync.differences: Same structure: state card, outbox rows with status, Sync now and Conflicts buttons. Build adds a 'Storage on this device' row.

Sync rejected.differences: Same card, reason line, Failed rows, Retry and View details.

Syncing.differences: Build keeps the stat cards, filter tabs and New record button while syncing; the design shows only the list. Rows waiting behind the uploading one keep their normal status instead of 'Waiting / Next in line'.

Tablet.differences: Same two-pane layout. Build adds stat cards and filter tabs in the list pane and a Delete button next to Edit; long titles wrap to two lines.
